projects.title: Vault projects
projects.description: One row per project note: status, focus, State prose, and counts of open tasks, waiting tasks and log entries. Exported from projects/*.md.
projects.name: vault-projects.json
projects.schedule: Re-exported from the vault after each brief and wrap

tasks.title: Open project tasks
tasks.description: One row per open task under a project's Next section, with owner, due date, repeat and who it waits on. Exported from projects/*.md.
tasks.name: vault-tasks.json
tasks.schedule: Re-exported from the vault after each brief and wrap

log.title: Project log entries
log.description: One row per dated line in a project's Log section, marked done, dropped or event. Exported from projects/*.md.
log.name: vault-log.json
log.schedule: Re-exported from the vault after each brief and wrap

days.title: Daily notes this week
days.description: One row per item in this week's daily notes: brief items (agent or user), week outcomes, meetings, decisions, captures, Claude did, and the wrap's done and moves. Exported from daily/*.md.
days.name: vault-days.json
days.schedule: Re-exported from the vault after each brief and wrap
